item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be very hot during the day and winds will be weak over Guangdong in the next few days. High temperatures will also trigger showers and thunderstorms. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Shanshan will intensify gradually and move northwards to the vicinity of the central part of Honshu of Japan in the next few days.
